description: Controller module for managing variables, including create, delete, retrieve, and update operations, using Express.js framework.

methods.name: createVariable
methods.description: Creates a new variable, associating it with the user's active organization and workspace.

methods.name: deleteVariable
methods.description: Deletes a variable by ID within the user's active workspace.

methods.name: getAllVariables
methods.description: Retrieves all variables for the user's active workspace with pagination.

methods.name: updateVariable
methods.description: Updates an existing variable identified by ID within the user's active workspace.
